title: Bound large-value rendering in the run inspector and the Events page (#259)
body:
Part of #259. Fixes #380.

## What changes

Every value the run inspector and the Events page show as text now goes through one `BoundedValue` component (`apps/web/src/components/ui/bounded-value.tsx`):

- Up to **4,096 characters** are laid out at once (the result, variables, messages, the full thread JSON); **1,024** inside a patch-diff column, a Node progress row and the Events table's payload cell. A larger value says "Showing the first N of M characters" and offers **Show all**, which puts the whole text in a named, keyboard-reachable scrolling region, and **Download JSON**, which saves the exact stored value.
- The bound is on what the page lays out, never on what is stored or executed: the engine's thread, events and results are untouched and the execution context is not truncated.
- The full thread JSON is built only while its disclosure is open (it was serialised on every render before, hidden or not).
- Thread reconstruction per selected event is remembered while a live log grows (`createThreadCache` in `apps/web/src/runs/projections.ts`, at most 32 results): an append no longer replays the whole log again for the event on screen.
- Node progress rows wrap at any character (`min-w-0 wrap-anywhere`), so a long single-line value no longer widens the document (#380).

Engineering parameters chosen here (not owner-approved numbers): 4,096 characters is about a hundred lines of pretty JSON, enough to read a value and small enough that a thread full of such values lays out without a long task; 1,024 for cells and rows keeps tables and drawers scannable; 32 cached reconstructions bound memory at a few threads' worth.

## Tests and evidence

- New component tests: `bounded-value.test.tsx` (7 cases: small values complete, bounded preview and Show all / Show less, cell bound, exact download, no download without a file name, text mode and empty text, long text), `ProgressDrawer.test.tsx` (one-line descriptions kept, large progress value bounded and rows wrapping), new cases in `RunInspectorPage.test.tsx` (result, variables, diff sides bounded; thread JSON built only when opened; Show all yields the exact value), `EventsPage.test.tsx` (payload cell bounded, exact value on Show all) and `projections.test.ts` (cache keeps results while the log grows, drops them for a changed seed or a rebuilt log, caps its size).
- Existing tests updated where the behaviour changed by design: the full thread JSON must be opened before it is read.
- Browser spec `apps/web/e2e/inspector-large-values.spec.ts` (Edge, 1440 px and 390 px): a 20,000-character single-line inference result; asserts the bounded result text, the notice, Show all with the full value in a focusable region, the bounded patch diff of the finished node, the bounded thread JSON, and that the document's scroll width does not exceed the window after Node progress is expanded. 2 of 2 passed on this head. Run against `main` (`dbf85086`) the same spec fails at its first assertion in both viewports (the result renders all 20,002 characters), so it does not reach the width check there; the width defect itself is the measured one recorded in #380.

Gates on this head (Node 22): `pnpm --filter @graphgoblin/web test:coverage` 118 files, 1,489 tests passed, statements 98.02 %, branches 94.91 %, functions 98.5 %, lines 98.94 %; `pnpm --filter @graphgoblin/web typecheck`, `lint`, Prettier check and `pnpm check:tokens` passed; the Edge spec 2/2.

## Docs

`docs/09-frontend-and-pwa.md` (run inspector: bounded rendering, exact access, cache) and the CHANGELOG bullet `(#259; fixes #380)`.

## Not in this change

Opening a transcript item's stored detail with its 16 KiB bound disclosed (#379) is a separate access gap, not a rendering bound.

## Process

Implemented by the orchestrating Claude session (register D-026); opposite-vendor review (GPT-6.1 Sol) and independent QA follow on this head, then the final adversarial audit (D-029). No merge before that audit's sign-off at the exact head.
